title: 词尾与词性
goal: 结合句法位置选择词性，并补出正确词尾和拼写形式。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 由句法位置判断所缺词的词性
补出正确的词尾并拼写正确

body.p: 同一词根可以形成不同词性：act 是动词，action 是名词，active 是形容词，actively 是副词。先看空格所在的结构，确定词性；再看已给字母和词长，确定词形。

body.box: The active group participated actively. Its participation was recorded.

body.p: active 修饰 group，actively 修饰 participated，participation 在 Its 后作主语。词尾选对后，还要核对整个词的长度和拼写。

cards.title: 句法位置
rows: 填名词；冠词和名词之间也可以是形容词。
The measurement is accurate. The accurate measurement is useful.
可接名词、形容词或分词，看后面的结构决定。
She is a chemist. The liquid is colorless. It is cooling.
接动词原形，不接过去式。
The team can simplify the design.
多为形容词，也可以是名词作定语。
及物动词后接名词作宾语，副词说明方式，系动词后接形容词。
They measured resistance. It moved slowly. It became stable.

cards.title: 名词后缀
rows: development：发展；the development of a device
density：密度；the density of a liquid
从事某事的人或执行功能的物
researcher：研究者；a researcher in a laboratory；operator：操作员；a trained operator
cards.note: 后缀能提示词性，但不能随意加在词根后。explain 的名词是 explanation。

cards.title: 动词词尾
rows: 一般现在时第三人称单数。
The sensor records pressure. The pump pushes water.
规则动词过去式或过去分词。
The staff tested the handle. It has been tested.
现在分词或动名词；与 be 构成进行时。
The motor is turning. Measuring takes time.
构成动词，意思是使成为某种状态。
The team will standardize the labels.
构成动词，意思是使成为某种状态。
The diagram can clarify the process.
可构成动词，要看句中位置确认。

cards.title: 形容词与副词后缀
rows: 多构成副词；friendly 这类词是形容词。
The wheel turns smoothly. a friendly assistant

body.box: The assistant is cut____ the sheet. After dry___, the sheet moves eas___. Its thic_____ is measured.

body.p: cutting：is 后面是进行时。cut 是重读闭音节，以一个辅音字母结尾，接 -ing 时双写 t。同类的有 stop → stopped。
drying：以辅音字母加 y 结尾的词，接 -ing 时保留 y，接 -ed 时 y 变 i，如 dry → dried。easily：easy 的副词是 easily，eas___ 补 ily。
thickness：Its 后面要名词作主语。thick 加 -ness 是 thickness，表示厚度，thic_____ 补 kness。
词尾是不发音的 e 时，去掉 e 再接 -ing，如 make → making。以 -ee 结尾时保留 e，如 see → seeing。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A theater stores costumes for several productions. The colle{ction} includes coats and hats. Each colo{rful} costume has a label. A new assi{stant} can orga{nize} the shelves and simp{lify} the records. Some materials are flex{ible}, but others tear eas{ily}. The manager records the cond{ition} of each item. A car{eful} inspection helps the staff work effic{iently}.
notes: collection：The 后作主语，需要名词 collection。
colorful：修饰 costume，用形容词 colorful。
assistant：冠词和形容词后作主语，需要表示人的名词。
organize：can 后接动词原形 organize。
simplify：与 organize 并列，沿用 can 后的原形。
flexible：are 后表示材料性质，用形容词 flexible。
easily：修饰 tear 的方式，用副词 easily。
condition：the 后作 records 的宾语，用名词 condition。
careful：修饰 inspection，用形容词 careful。
efficiently：修饰 work，用副词 efficiently。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A map designer prepares symbols for a walking guide. Yesterday she pla{nned} a new layout and cop{ied} several street names. Today she is mak{ing} the symbols larger and chec{king} their shapes. She class{ifies} roads by type and ident{ifies} public buildings. The symbols must be read{able} at a small size. Their cla{rity} matters more than decoration. A test reader works slo{wly} through the guide and checks each conne{ction} between two paths.
notes: planned：plan 的过去式双写 n，再加 -ed。
copied：copy 的过去式把 y 变 i，再加 -ed。
making：make 接 -ing 去掉末尾 e。
checking：check 接 -ing 不双写末尾辅音字母。
classifies：classify 的第三人称单数把 y 变 i，加 -es。
identifies：identify 的第三人称单数为 identifies。
readable：read 加 -able，表示可读的。
clarity：clear 的名词是 clarity，词根的拼法有变化。
slowly：slow 加 -ly 构成副词。
connection：connect 加 -ion 构成 connection，末尾是 -tion。

cards.title: 练习三　词性与词尾

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A furniture maker compares finishes for a wooden desk. The compa{rison} begins with two samples. One finish is colo{rless} and leaves the grain visible. The other gives the wood a nat{ural} brown shade. The maker is rub{bing} each surface with cloth and not{ing} any marks. Yesterday both samples were dr{ied} indoors. Their smoot{hness} is checked by touch. An exper{ienced} worker can eval{uate} the results and apply the chosen finish care{fully}.
notes: comparison：The 后作主语，compare 对应名词 comparison。
colorless：color 加 -less，表示无色的。
natural：修饰 brown shade，用形容词 natural。
rubbing：rub 接 -ing 双写 b。
noting：note 接 -ing 去掉不发音的 e。
dried：dry 的过去分词把 y 变 i，再加 -ed。
smoothness：Their 后作主语，用名词 smoothness。
experienced：修饰 worker，用形容词 experienced。
evaluate：can 后用原形 evaluate。
carefully：careful 加 -ly 为 carefully，保留原有 l。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A laboratory technician grows crystals from a solution. The form{ation} of crystals begins as the liquid cools. An assi{stant} records the temperature care{fully} and notes any vis{ible} changes. Yesterday the technician sto{pped} the trial early because the container was leaking. Today she is us{ing} a new container and comp{aring} the results. A scie{ntist} will eval{uate} the final samples. Their hard{ness} is measured after they have been removed from the liquid. Each sample receives a label showing when it was collected.

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A design class is examining ramps at building entrances. The measu{rement} of each slope takes several minutes. A port{able} device records the angle, and a student checks the reading repea{tedly}. Yesterday the class stu{died} a steep ramp beside a shop. Today students are plan{ning} an alternative and wri{ting} a short report. The new plan will simp{lify} access without blocking the door. Its prac{tical} advantages include space for turning. A compa{rison} with the old ramp helps explain the proposed impro{vement}.
